k:互.mnemonic: Two pigs share one (一) trough. Each pushes its snout (彑) in from its own side, and each makes room for the other. Mutually (reciprocally, together, shared).
k:互.hint: Two pigs at a shared trough.

k:厳.mnemonic: A teacher stands under the overhang (厂) with a sparkle (⺌) of fury in his eye. Whisper, and he will strike (攵) the desk right beside your ear (耳). Stern (strictness, severity, rigidity).
k:厳.hint: Teacher cracking the desk by your ear.

k:昔.mnemonic: The road of years must bend (曲) three (三) times before you reach the place where every old tale begins, further back than anyone alive remembers. Once upon a time (antiquity, old times).
k:昔.hint: Three turns back down the years.

k:依.mnemonic: A leader (亻) who cannot fasten his own garment (衣). Each morning he stands with his arms out and waits for someone to dress him. Reliant (depend on, consequently, therefore).

k:摘.mnemonic: The speaker at the podium (啇) is facing (向) the crowd when fingers (扌) dart in from the side and pinch the flower from his buttonhole. Pluck (pick, pinch, trim).
k:摘.hint: Flower pinched from the speaker's buttonhole.

k:痛.mnemonic: The patient on the sickbed (疒) bites down on a muzzle (マ) of cloth while the doctor carries out the task (用) of setting the broken bone. Pain (hurt, damage, bruise).
k:痛.hint: Biting cloth while the bone is set.

k:塁.mnemonic: A rice field (田) turned into a winter ball diamond: mounds of soil (土) at the corners, icicles (冫) on the fence, and runners sliding from one mound to the next. Bases (fort, rampart, walls).

k:紅.mnemonic: The construction (工) of a wedding robe: every thread (糸) is dipped in safflower dye until it glows the deepest red. Crimson (deep red).
k:紅.hint: Robe threads dipped in safflower dye.

k:寒.mnemonic: Under the roof (宀) the well (井) has frozen over, and two drips of ice hang beneath it. Even indoors your breath steams. Cold.

k:漫.mnemonic: A funny strip in the day (日) paper: a fisherman's net (罒) hauls in a whole tsunami (氵), and the fisherman also (又), drawn in wobbly lines with a speech bubble. Cartoon (unrestrained, involuntarily).
k:漫.hint: Funny strip in the daily paper.

k:砲.mnemonic: Wrap (包) a round stone (石) in wadding, ram it down the barrel and light the fuse. With a boom the stone flies over the castle wall. Cannon (gun).
k:砲.hint: Wadded stone rammed down a barrel.

k:揮.mnemonic: The general's fingers (扌) close round his baton and he swings it over his head so that the whole army (軍) can see which way to charge. Brandish (wave, swing, shake).

k:索.mnemonic: Ten (十) lengths of thread (糸) twisted together and tied round the forehead (冖) like a headband, strong enough to haul a bucket or to follow back out of a maze. Cord (rope, searching, inquiring).

k:鈴.mnemonic: A tiny ball of gold (金) on a ribbon. When it tinkles, the servants know that orders (令) are coming. Small bell (buzzer).

k:募.mnemonic: At dusk (暮) the captain goes round the taverns looking for more power (力): strong arms to sign on before the ship sails at first light. Recruit (campaign, enlist).
k:募.hint: Captain signing up crew at sunset.

k:戒.mnemonic: Twenty (廾) hands are raised before a guard's halberd (戈), swearing to obey the rule carved on the stone behind him. Break it and face the blade. Commandment.
k:戒.hint: Hands raised before the guard's blade.

k:均.mnemonic: Soil (土) raked so flat that a cradle (勹) set down on it does not rock at all, and two icicles (冫) laid inside stay put without rolling. Level (average, flat, even).

k:借.mnemonic: A leader (亻) takes twenty (廾) coins from you, just for one day (日), he says. You write it down and count the days until you see them again. Borrow (rent).
k:借.hint: Twenty coins, just for one day.

k:孫.mnemonic: A child (子) holding the far end of the lineage (系), the family thread running on past you: the child of your child. Grandchild (descendants).
k:孫.hint: Child at the end of the family thread.

k:箱.mnemonic: Strips of bamboo (竹) woven over and under in mutual (相) support, each holding the next in place, until four sides and a lid stand up. Box (chest, case, bin).

k:隣.mnemonic: Over the mound (阝) there is a rice (米) harvest party, and you can see dancing legs (舛) kicking above the ridge. The people next door are celebrating. Neighboring.

k:柄.mnemonic: Open the book (本) and look inside (内): the endpapers are printed with a repeating motif of cranes and waves. Design (pattern, build, nature).
k:柄.hint: Cranes and waves on the endpapers.

k:臨.mnemonic: A retainer (臣) leans over, eyes down and to the right (右), where the goods (品) are stacked. He attends to them, ready for whatever comes. Look to (face, meet, attend).

k:免.mnemonic: A rabbit seen from the side: ears up, a big eye, and two legs bounding away beneath. It has slipped the trap and been let off. Excuse (dismissal).

k:煙.mnemonic: A fire (火) smoulders under a heap of soil (土), and a grey plume drifts off to the west (西) on the evening wind. Smoke.

k:紹.mnemonic: A thread (糸) ties two strangers together: with his mouth (口) the host names each one, and they lay aside the sword (刀) and bow. Introduce (inherit, help).

k:桜.mnemonic: A woman (女) sits beneath a tree (木) as its pink petals sparkle (⺌) down onto her hair. Everyone picnics under this tree in spring. Cherry.
k:桜.hint: Pink petals falling on a picnic.

k:灯.mnemonic: A small fire (火) on a hooked stand. The day's work is complete (了), so you light it and sit down to read. Lamp (a light, bright, brightness).
k:灯.hint: Small flame on a hooked stand.

k:縁.mnemonic: A thread (糸) of fate runs from the girl with the broom (ヨ) to the boy herding the pig (豕). They have never met, but they are already tied. Affinity (relation, connection, edge).
k:縁.hint: Fate's thread from broom to pig.

k:兼.mnemonic: A cleaner grips a broom (ヨ) and a stick (｜) in one (一) fist, wearing a helmet with horns (丷) and flippers like fins (ハ): sweeper, fencer, Viking and diver all at once. Concurrently (and, beforehand, in advance).
